hotels.description: Treat the family to the magic of the Whitsundays with a stay at the impressive Daydream Island Resort, accessed only by boat or helicopter for truly secluded beauty. This idyllic escape is your gateway to the UNESCO World Heritage-listed Great Barrier Reef, just five kilometres off the mainland, surrounded by lush rainforest and a fringe of picturesque shoreline. One of the best ways to enjoy this stunning part of Queensland, the Great Barrier Reef and surrounding islands, Daydream Island Resort offers three restaurants, a revitalised pool area and a manmade free-form coral lagoon wrapping 200 metres around the central building. From snorkelling to kayaking, there are many ways to enjoy this natural wonder, teeming with colourful marine life. As one of 74 islands in the Whitsundays, this hideaway is the perfect launchpad for boating on these crystal-clear waters. Alternatively, hike through dense rainforest and emerge on a new stretch of impossibly white sand.
